meta.title: Fallen Starfire - 3
meta.description: In the abyss of slaughter, the warriors behold a miraculous starlight shining through the darkness.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah... Looks like those Sanctifiers didn't follow us...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah... Looks like those Sanctifiers didn't follow us...

spans.text: Hah... Hah... Looks like those Sanctifiers didn't follow us...

units.rawText: Don't know what kinda tricks they used, but it sure was very effective!
units.displayText: Don't know what kinda tricks they used, but it sure was very effective!

spans.text: Don't know what kinda tricks they used, but it sure was very effective!

units.rawText: Countless wounds covering Sol's body stand in stark contrast to her radiant smile. Seeing her like this fills me with sadness and guilt.
units.displayText: Countless wounds covering Sol's body stand in stark contrast to her radiant smile. Seeing her like this fills me with sadness and guilt.

spans.text: Countless wounds covering Sol's body stand in stark contrast to her radiant smile. Seeing her like this fills me with sadness and guilt.

units.rawText: Phew. Persicaria, you made a good call to hide some resources elsewhere, so we didn't end up losing everything. Let's go retrieve what we hid.
units.displayText: Phew. Persicaria, you made a good call to hide some resources elsewhere, so we didn't end up losing everything. Let's go retrieve what we hid.

spans.text: Phew. Persicaria, you made a good call to hide some resources elsewhere, so we didn't end up losing everything. Let's go retrieve what we hid.

units.rawText: Sol moves in suddenly and flicks my forehead before I can react.
units.displayText: Sol moves in suddenly and flicks my forehead before I can react.

spans.text: Sol moves in suddenly and flicks my forehead before I can react.

units.rawText: It'd better hurt! That's the punishment for your monologue back then.
units.displayText: It'd better hurt! That's the punishment for your monologue back then.

spans.text: It'd better hurt! That's the punishment for your monologue back then.

units.rawText: Take it as a reminder that I don't wanna hear anything like self-destruction or any kind of self-sacrifice again. Next time you pull that, it'll be far worse than just a flick.
units.displayText: Take it as a reminder that I don't wanna hear anything like self-destruction or any kind of self-sacrifice again. Next time you pull that, it'll be far worse than just a flick.

spans.text: Take it as a reminder that I don't wanna hear anything like self-destruction or any kind of self-sacrifice again. Next time you pull that, it'll be far worse than just a flick.

units.rawText: Mmm... There won't be a next time.
units.displayText: Mmm... There won't be a next time.

spans.text: Mmm... There won't be a next time.

units.rawText: Don't give up your life in any circumstances. Like today, hang on a bit longer, and a miracle will come!
units.displayText: Don't give up your life in any circumstances. Like today, hang on a bit longer, and a miracle will come!

spans.text: Don't give up your life in any circumstances. Like today, hang on a bit longer, and a miracle will come!

units.rawText: I rub my forehead, where the pain still lingers, as I recall the person who saved us moments ago.
units.displayText: I rub my forehead, where the pain still lingers, as I recall the person who saved us moments ago.

spans.text: I rub my forehead, where the pain still lingers, as I recall the person who saved us moments ago.

units.rawText: Miracle... I sure hope it'll work out that way.
units.displayText: Miracle... I sure hope it'll work out that way.

spans.text: Miracle... I sure hope it'll work out that way.

units.rawText: I glance in the direction Sol's pointing. The "miracle" she mentioned is moving toward us.
units.displayText: I glance in the direction Sol's pointing. The "miracle" she mentioned is moving toward us.

spans.text: I glance in the direction Sol's pointing. The "miracle" she mentioned is moving toward us.

units.rawText: I read the name tag as it shakes with their movement. The job title and the honorific are all too familiar, yet the name doesn't belong to the one I know intimately—the one who ought to hold these titles.
units.displayText: I read the name tag as it shakes with their movement. The job title and the honorific are all too familiar, yet the name doesn't belong to the one I know intimately—the one who ought to hold these titles.

spans.text: I read the name tag as it shakes with their movement. The job title and the honorific are all too familiar, yet the name doesn't belong to the one I know intimately—the one who ought to hold these titles.

units.displayText: Director of Project Neural Cloud, Professor {교수}.

spans.text: Director of Project Neural Cloud, Professor
